name: bloomkin-backend
description: Firebase backend for Bloomkin: Firestore and Storage rules, Cloud Functions, and their tests.

scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-bloomkin "vitest run tests/firestore.rules.test.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project dev $([ -d .emulator-data ] && echo --import ./.emulator-data) --export-on-exit ./.emulator-data
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-bloomkin "vitest run tests/integration"
